cohort: Twin-bearing ewes with induced placental insufficiency for FGR, delivering preterm lambs (appropriately grown or FGR) that were then ventilated.
finding: UCB therapy attenuated ventilation-induced lung injury in appropriately grown lambs, but in FGR lambs, UCB further decreased septal crest density and increased collagen deposition while also increasing angiogenesis.
birth_weight: N/A (lambs were either 'appropriately grown' or 'growth restricted')
gest_age: FGR induced at 88 days gestation, lambs delivered preterm at ~126 days gestation (term is 150 days)
